heading: School Board Advances Change to Governance Policy
summary: The board debated a revision to Governance Culture Policy 9 and approved it on a roll call vote. The chair said changes to this type of policy require at least five votes. The revision was to return for a second reading.

heading: Wisconsin Releases Clean Energy Plan Progress Report
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: State officials released an update on work under Wisconsin's Clean Energy Plan. The report covers efforts to expand clean energy infrastructure, reduce household energy costs and rely less on out-of-state energy. It also tracks progress toward the plan's job creation goals.
